critical_code_review_comments: bump_lead_on_application uses find(...).to_list(2000) then Python-side phone normalization — fine at current scale but O(N) per submission across the whole pre_app cohort. Consider storing a normalized phone (last-10) as an indexed field and matching directly. Not blocking.
The pre_app tuple in leads.py:204 is duplicated conceptually with OPEN_STATUSES + 'converted' + 'application_submitted'. Minor DRY note — could be derived to reduce drift risk.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 54 fix (broadened pre_app match set) is fully verified end-to-end. Regression on iteration 48 TestAutoBump also passes. Future related work should focus on the O(N) scan noted in code review comments if lead volume grows large.
rca_of_the_issue: User reported: cascade converted→application_submitted→fee_paid was not firing. RCA: bump_lead_on_application filtered candidates by status IN ('converted','application_submitted') only, so real-world leads still sitting at 'new'/'interested'/'follow_up' never matched even when their phone matched an /apply submission. Fix (already applied by main agent): relaxed the $in list to also include 'new','not_connected','interested','follow_up'. Now every pre-application lead cascades correctly while terminal statuses (fee_paid, completed, admission_confirmed, lost, not_turned) remain untouched.
